title: How to Access All Features in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Introduction to Homepages and Feature Access
Accessing All Features and Keyboard Shortcuts

features.name: Role-based Homepages
features.description: Business Central provides customizable homepages tailored to different roles including business manager, accountant, sales and relationships manager, and project manager. Each homepage surfaces activities and information relevant to that role.

features.name: Business Manager Homepage
features.description: The business manager homepage gathers activities and information to keep a business running smoothly, including sales and purchase documents, payments needing attention, and balances displayed up front.

features.name: Accountant Homepage
features.description: The accountant homepage lets users monitor payments and approvals, view finance performance charts, and work with accounts receivable and accounts payable.

features.name: Sales and Relationships Homepage
features.description: The sales and relationships homepage helps control sales processes by allowing users to stay on top of opportunities, send sales quotes, manage campaigns, and track pipeline sales.

features.name: Project Manager Homepage
features.description: The project manager homepage provides an overview of work in process on current projects, helps stay on budget, and allows users to set up jobs, plan tasks, manage resources, and purchase items and supplies.

features.name: Homepage Activity Tiles
features.description: The tiles in the activity section of homepages provide quick access to daily tasks like processing orders or invoices.

features.name: Homepage Charts
features.description: Charts on homepages offer up-to-date information that supports decisions. Users can customize the period a chart shows or switch to another chart through section headings.

features.name: Menu Header Feature Access
features.description: Clicking the menu header opens all features in Business Central. Users can expand the explore more roles section to discover additional roles.

features.name: Search Bar for Page Discovery
features.description: Users can search for particular pages using the search bar to quickly locate features across Business Central.

features.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.description: Users can press the Alt key to trigger keyboard shortcuts. For example, Alt-J-S opens sales quotes. This provides quick access to frequently used pages.
